clue.text: See 10
A high throw turned to what's turned on

indicators.note: turned means the word for the high throw is set backwards

parts.note: in cricket a six is a hit clearing the boundary without bouncing, a lofted throw-like shot

explanation.surface: Someone describes a lofted throw that changed direction.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a hit that clears the boundary without bouncing scores six runs; 'turned' sets that word backwards after A.
explanation.definitionFit: An axis is the line or pivot about which something rotates.

clue.text: Treatment prescribed for case of infection

definitions.meaning: a measured quantity of medicine given by a doctor
informally, a bout of illness, as in catching a nasty one of flu

explanation.surface: A doctor decides what to give a patient with an infection.
explanation.definitionFit: A dose is both a measured portion of medicine and, colloquially, a bout of an illness.

clue.text: Work out with soldiers when working

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
on means operating or working, as of a machine

explanation.surface: Someone plans an exercise routine alongside troops on duty.
explanation.definitionFit: To reason something is to deduce it, to think it through logically.

clue.text: 10 mixture, about to make people lose weight, is a revelation

indicators.note: about means the stirred letters sit around the rest
a mixture stirs the letters of the number into a new order

parts.note: the number ten, spelt out
to lighten men is to make people less heavy

explanation.surface: A dietary concoction that slims people down is presented as a breakthrough.
explanation.walkthrough: '10' is not the cross-reference but the number TEN; 'mixture' turns it into ENT, and 'about' wraps that around LIGHTEN MEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Enlightenment is a sudden understanding, an insight disclosed, which is what a revelation brings.

clue.text: Encephalitic cod digested in stomach

indicators.note: in places the stirred fish inside the word for stomach

parts.note: maw is an old word for an animal's stomach or gullet

indicators.note: digested food is broken down, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A piece of cod being digested in someone's belly causes brain trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digested' makes DCO from COD, which goes 'in' MAW. Mad cow disease (BSE) is a brain disorder of cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Mad cow disease is bovine spongiform encephalopathy, a disease affecting the brain.

clue.text: Goldsmith's check on account that's concealing heart of metal

indicators.note: concealing means the Latin phrase hides a letter inside it

parts.note: id est is Latin for 'that is', abbreviated i.e.

indicators.note: heart of picks the central letter of the word metal

explanation.surface: A goldsmith verifies an account that hides some metal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' is the Latin phrase behind the abbreviation i.e.; 'concealing' hides the central letter of metal within it.
explanation.definitionFit: An acid test was used to show whether metal was genuine gold, hence any decisive trial.

clue.text: It's a cleric's job to climb one mountain in dangerous surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings means the risky word encloses the reversed pieces

parts.note: chancy means risky or dangerous

indicators.note: in a down clue, to climb means to read the pieces upwards, backwards

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
an alp is a high mountain

explanation.surface: A clergyman's role is to scale a peak amid perils.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'to climb' reads the pieces upward, so they are reversed before going inside the risky word.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaplaincy is the office or post held by a chaplain, a type of cleric.

clue.text: Film maker's day off in product of 27, say

indicators.note: in places the jumbled day inside the garment

parts.note: knitting yields woollen goods; 27 across is knitting

indicators.note: off means gone wrong, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A director takes a day's leave, wrapped in a hand-knitted jumper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' turns DAY into DYA, which goes 'in' WOOLLEN, a typical product of 27 (knitting).
explanation.definitionFit: Woody Allen is an American director known for films such as Annie Hall.

clue.text: Popular ruler accepting everything by God's will

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: accepting means the ruler takes another word inside

parts.note: a shah was a monarch of Iran
all means everything

explanation.surface: A well-liked monarch takes on all things by divine permission.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arabic expression means 'if God wills', used of hoped-for future events.

clue.text: Tale teller, having broken shin twice, narrates dance

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so the letters are reassembled
twice means the word shin is used two times

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A storyteller with a doubly injured leg tells of a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: SHIN SHIN NARRATES DANCE, 21 letters, is 'broken' into the full name across three lights.
explanation.definitionFit: The Danish author wrote fairy tales such as The Little Mermaid, so he is a famous teller of tales.

clue.text: Setter's past the mature stage

parts.note: the setter refers to themself, so setter's is I'm, I am
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: The puzzle-maker claims to have outgrown adulthood.
explanation.definitionFit: An imago is the final, adult form of an insect after metamorphosis.

clue.text: Dupe officer with Italian brother in arms by inheritance

parts.note: to con is to dupe or trick
GEN is short for general, a senior officer
an ally fights on your side

explanation.surface: An officer is fooled along with an Italian comrade.
explanation.definitionFit: Congenitally means from birth, as a trait one is born with, much as inherited.

clue.text: Beats bloodsucker's upper legs

parts.note: drums means beats, as one drums fingers
a tick is a blood-sucking parasite; the 's is its possessive

explanation.surface: Someone thrashes a parasite's thighs.
explanation.definitionFit: Drumsticks are the lower legs of cooked poultry, here taken as the upper part of a leg.

clue.text: When to eat outside pub — merited getting drunk

indicators.note: outside means the scrambled word goes around the pub
someone drunk is muddled, so the letters are mixed

parts.note: an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: Outside a bar, someone who earned it gets plastered at mealtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting drunk' makes D ERTIME from MERITED, which goes 'outside' INN.
explanation.definitionFit: Dinnertime is the hour of the main meal, the time for eating.

clue.text: Voice objections to the transport system

definitions.meaning: the railway, as in travelling by train

explanation.surface: Someone complains about public transport.
explanation.definitionFit: To rail is to protest angrily, and rail is the railway network.

clue.text: Keeps money box motionless

parts.note: a shop stocks goods, keeps them
a till is a cash drawer

explanation.surface: A shop holds its cash register steady.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock-still means utterly unmoving.

clue.text: Fired one for interrupting brand new Old Socialist

indicators.note: interrupting means the pieces break into the word for new

parts.note: in mint condition means brand new
lit means set alight, fired
a means one

explanation.surface: A veteran left-winger is sacked in favour of a newcomer.
explanation.walkthrough: Militant was a Trotskyist group within the British Labour Party in the 1980s.
explanation.definitionFit: A militant was a member of the Militant Tendency, an old far-left socialist faction.

clue.text: Cardinal number (unspecified) among medics getting discount

indicators.note: among places the unknown number within the doctors

parts.note: MOs are medical officers
n stands for an unspecified number in maths
to discount something is to ignore it

explanation.surface: A churchman counts amid doctors offering a price cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinal' looks like a number word next to 'number'; it is the church title.
explanation.definitionFit: Monsignore is an Italian honorific for senior clergy, including cardinals.

clue.text: Spots part of London, as the locals say

indicators.note: Londoners in a Cockney accent drop the opening h

parts.note: Hackney is a borough of east London

explanation.surface: A Londoner points out a district in the local accent.
explanation.walkthrough: HACKNEY is a London borough; a Cockney drops the H and says 'Ackney', which sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Acne is a skin condition producing pimples, which are spots.

clue.text: Narrows definition of second feature

parts.note: a trait is a characteristic feature

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry pins down a minor characteristic.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait is a narrow channel of sea; the narrows is the same thing.

clue.text: Act evasively with royal donors in the gallery

indicators.note: in places the royal givers inside the gallery

parts.note: the Tate is a famous London art gallery
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the royal cipher
givers are donors

explanation.surface: A gallery behaves shiftily about royal benefactors.
explanation.walkthrough: The TATE is a group of London art galleries.
explanation.definitionFit: To tergiversate is to equivocate or change sides, dodging commitment.

clue.text: Turning dull island into holiday region

indicators.note: turning means the word for dull is read backwards

parts.note: dim means dull, lacking brightness

explanation.surface: Converting a drab island into a resort area.
explanation.definitionFit: The Midi is the south of France, a popular holiday destination.

clue.text: Unduly pleased with the south face

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
mug is slang for a face

explanation.surface: A self-satisfied look from the south.
explanation.definitionFit: Smug means excessively pleased with oneself.

clue.text: Tea carrying in type of tea

indicators.note: carrying means the tea word holds the next word inside

parts.note: cha (or char) is slang for tea

explanation.surface: A cuppa containing a particular blend.
explanation.definitionFit: China tea is a variety of tea grown in China, distinct from Indian.

clue.text: Ancestral loyalty to island's in a healthy state

indicators.note: in places the island's name within the fit state

parts.note: being in trim means being fit and healthy
Bali is an Indonesian island; 's adds S

explanation.surface: Faithfulness to an island comes with good health.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribalism is strong loyalty to one's tribe or kin group.

clue.text: Hustle curious enquirer

indicators.note: curious means odd or strange, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nosy questioner bustles about.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleuth is a detective, someone who investigates and asks questions.

clue.text: Monarch's getting m-money back in for needlework

indicators.note: in places the reversed money inside the monarch

parts.note: king is a monarch; the 's is a link

indicators.note: back means the stammered money is read in reverse

parts.note: tin is slang for money; the stammer doubles its first letter

explanation.surface: A ruler stutters about getting cash back for sewing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'm-money' is a stammer: TIN (money) with its first letter doubled, TTIN; 'back' turns it to NITT, set 'in' KING.
explanation.definitionFit: Knitting is making fabric with needles, a form of needlework.
